assumptions: The Poland-Scheraga recursion as DECIPHER implements it, at the stated salt and strand conditions.
limits: An equilibrium model: ramp rate and dye chemistry are not in it.
Domains are the model's cooperative units, not measured peaks.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the helicity curve itself, which the outputs carry; the Melting temperature panel draws it and writes no reading over it.
bio.jane/contract.question: How does this molecule melt: the helicity curve, its Tm50, and the domains that melt together behind each HRM peak?

description: DNA melting behaviour of the subject by the Poland–Scheraga model (DECIPHER): the melt curve (mean helicity vs temperature), its Tm50, and the cooperatively-melting domains behind each HRM peak.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

ions.description: molar sodium-equivalent concentration. Defaults to DECIPHER's own 0.2 M; the editor substitutes the project's shared Na⁺ instead. In M.

region_end.description: 0-based inclusive end. Unset = the whole sequence. Advanced.

region_start.description: 0-based inclusive start of the region to melt. Unset = the whole sequence; pass the selection's start to scope to it. Advanced.

step.description: grid spacing; finer costs proportionally more. In °C.

name: melt_profile

hrmPlot.description: the HRM trace as a plot: −dθ/dT against temperature, one peak per melting domain

meltPlot.description: the melt curve as a plot: mean helicity against temperature

tm50.description: temperature where mean helicity crosses 0.5 (null if the range never crosses it)
